---
title: Quickstart
---

Paneltime jointly estimates panel, ARIMA, and GARCH structure. This is useful
when observations have group and time dimensions and both the conditional mean
and conditional variance are dynamic.

## Install

```{python}
#| eval: false
%pip install paneltime pandas
```

## Fit a model

The v2 API follows the familiar model/results pattern used by `statsmodels`
and `arch`.

```{python}
#| eval: false
import paneltime as pt

model = pt.PanelARIMAGARCH(
    "Inflation ~ Gross_Savings + Interest_rate",
    data,
    entity="country",
    time="date",
)
results = model.fit(
    order=(2, 2, 1),
    garch_order=(2, 2),
    vol="EGARCH",
)
print(results.summary())
```

`data` may be a flat `DataFrame` with `entity` and `time` columns, or a
`DataFrame` indexed by `(entity, time)`.

## Inspect results

```{python}
#| eval: false
print(results.params)
print(results.conf_int())
forecast = results.forecast(steps=4)
```

See [Results object](api/results.qmd) for the complete public result surface.
